spans.s: क्षोड m. The post to which an elephant is fastened.
क्षोणि f. 1. The earth; 2. the number ‘one’ (in math.)
क्षोणि f. 1. The earth; 2. the number ‘one’ (in math.)
क्षोद m. 1. Pounding, grinding; 2. the stone on which anything is powdered; 3. dust, a particle.
क्षोद-क्षम a. standing to scrutiny or investigation.

क्षोभ m. 1. Shaking, moving, tossing, Megh.i.28, ii.32; 2. jolting, R.i.58; 3. agitation, emotion, disturbance, अथेंद्रियक्षोभमयुग्मनेत्रः पुनर्वशित्वाद्बलवान्नगृह्यः K.S.iii.69, प्रायः स्वं महिमानं क्षोभात्प्रतिपद्यते हि जनः Sak.vi.
क्षोभण (II) m. One of the five arrows of Kāmadeva.
क्षोम m.n. A room on the top of a house.
